resources.string: E39 and cars before 2007 (K-line): use the K+DCAN USB cable with the pin 7/8 switch in the old position (bridged). ELM327 and ENET do not work with these cars. On E39 before 09/2000 you may need the adapter for the round 20-pin connector in the engine bay.
Warning: ENET only works with F/G series (Ethernet connection). It does not work for an E39.
Warning: the ELM327 only works with D-CAN cars (approx. 2007 onwards). It does not work for an E39.
